definitionZh: 边角右 CSS 属性将边角区域设置在一个元素的右侧. 一个正值使它离邻居更远,而负值使它更近.
sourceDefinition: The margin-right CSS property sets the margin area on the right side of an element. A positive value places it farther from its neighbors, while a negative value places it closer.
